name: outcome_grader
description: Independent post-session judge that grades a finished session's completion from the overview supplied with its task; observer-only, returns a single verdict (achieved | partially_achieved | failed | aborted).

unmappedExclusions.*: home excluded_tools is empty — the deny list is a pure dsh design decision from home capabilities: capabilities [] means no CodeExecution, no NetworkAccess, no AgentSpawn/AgentMessage. The grader judges only the overview injected with its task, so execution (bash/pwsh), mutation (write/edit), network, messaging, spawn, present, job_kill, and goal-management tools are denied; read-only inspection stays granted but the verdict never needs it.

completion.description: One of: achieved | partially_achieved | failed | aborted
